fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A closing bite that deals 24 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target first, then strike for 14 damage and leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Found
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarry After Quarry
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 15 seconds.
